title: Printable Love Coupons for Him or Her, Valentines Day Gift for Boyfriend Girlfriend, Love Coupon Book, Last Minute Anniversary Gift PDF
description:
A sweet, fun Valentine's gift they'll actually use. Print, cut and staple into a little book of love coupons, ready in minutes.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Cover page with To / From
- 12 ready-made love coupons (Breakfast in Bed, Movie Night, Date Night Out, No Chores Day, Win One Argument and more)
- 3 blank coupons to write your own ideas
- How-to page
- 2 PDF files: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4

HOW TO USE
1. Download the PDF from Etsy: Purchases and Reviews > Download Files
2. Print at 100% scale on card stock or thick paper
3. Cut along the dashed lines, fill in the names and staple into a book

PERFECT FOR
Valentine's Day, anniversaries, birthdays, long-distance couples, or a last-minute gift for your boyfriend, girlfriend, husband or wife.

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
- Colors may vary slightly depending on your screen and printer.
- For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.
- Designed with the help of AI tools, then reviewed and finalized by me.
